name: Jingdezhen blue-and-white small tea cup
where: Jiangxi Arts and Crafts Gallery shop, Beijing (Donglu 107)
about: A small porcelain tea cup decorated in cobalt blue under the glaze, a style Jingdezhen is famous for. It represents Jiangxi Province's craft tradition.
tip: This is a Jiangxi craft, not a Nanchang product. Don't mistake it for a local Nanchang item.
